messages:
elaine: Heads-up: we're doing a lightweight docs sweep for the upcoming v1->v2 deprecation. Goal: ensure redirects, migration guide, and all SDK snippets are updated. Target: PRs open by Friday noon.

sam: on it. I'll assemble a prioritized checklist of pages and examples. Suggest we focus on: chat endpoints, embeddings model aliases, client instantiation patterns, and any examples using `api_key`.

katie: I started a small redirect manifest. Will add any paths we find. Draft entry style: ```json
{ "from": "/v1/chat", "to": "/v2/chat", "code": 301 }
```

miguel: quick note: TS snippets across guides still show `new Client(apiKey)` positional form. For v2 we prefer `new Client({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN })`. I'll patch and include before/after diff in PRs.

ajay: Python snippets too: replace `Client(api_key=...)` with `Client(token=...)`. Also adding a short appendix in the migration guide about auth rename.

sam: embeddings: we found a few tutorials referencing `embed-legacy` and assuming 512 dims. New `embed-1` is 768. Need a short note about reindexing and a vector-normalize helper.

elaine: add a small CLI example for reindexing and a code snippet to L2-normalize vectors after re-embed. Keep it optional but linked prominently.

ajay: proposed CLI: ```bash
redwood index reindex --from=old_index --to=new_index --model=embed-1 --workers=8
```

katie: also flagging a partner tutorial (external) that calculates similarity with an implicit scale factor. I'll add a callout: "verify similarity thresholds after reindex" and show a one-line normalize.

miguel: CI change: I'll update the snippet-linter to error on literal strings containing `/v1/` or `embed-legacy`. Rule: warn on PRs, escalate to error one week before redirect activation.

sam: smoke tests: we should run a tiny job that execs key examples against staging v2 and checks 200 + shape of responses. Ajay, can you own a minimal harness and attach run logs to each PR?

ajay: yep. I'll create `docs/smoke/v2-harness` and add to PR checklist. Running examples: chat simple prompt, embed shape for 3 items, and a small streaming example.

elaine: ownership summary: sam -> doc checklist + migration guide text; katie -> redirects + deprecation entry; miguel -> TS snippet updates + lint rule; ajay -> Python snippets + smoke harness. I'll review all PRs.

katie: timeline: PRs opened Fri noon, reviews Mon morning, merge Tue backup window. Banner/post scheduled Wed AM (docs-bot will handle).

docs-bot: :robot_face: I will auto-post the deprecation banner after `docs/deprecations/v1-sunset.md` merges. Please include the `announce_date` field in that file (ISO8601).

sam: small edge-case: examples that build raw HTTP requests with `/v1/` in curl bodies. I will grep and add replacements or doc comments highlighting the new endpoint.

miguel: also check SDK changelogs. Any breaking change needs an explicit `BREAKING` header and short migration snippet in the changelog entry.

ajay: question: do we want to publish a short script to help customers detect which indexes reference `embed-legacy`? I can sketch a `redwood-cli index scan --pattern=embed-legacy` command and include it in migration notes.

elaine: good idea. Add as optional tooling in the migration appendix. Mark as experimental.

katie: blocker: there's a code sample in the quickstart that relies on old streaming framing from v1. I opened a quick PR but need an approver for streaming semantics changes. @miguel can you eyeball?

miguel: will review streaming PR. If we change framing, include a `diff` block showing old vs new. Keep examples tiny.

sam: final checklist item: update the SDK example test matrix (node/py versions) so these snippet changes are validated in CI. I'll add that to the PR templates.

elaine: thanks. If anyone finds a tricky cross-repo dependency (partner repos, examples in blog posts), flag it here and we'll route to solutions engineering to help partners. :handshake:
